content: If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is less than six hours before your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double up on doses to make up for the missed one. Store the medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Keep tablets in their original container, and for pellets, do not open the packets until you are ready to use them. Avoid storing the medication in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of the product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in August 2024. It is important to note that this is a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your individual health needs. Before starting this medication, and periodically during and after treatment, laboratory tests such as liver function tests and screenings for hepatitis B and C should be conducted. If this medication is being used in combination with ribavirin, female patients or female partners of male patients should take a pregnancy test before beginning treatment.
